sidebar.deleteDescription: The connection and its sharing are removed from PatchMan. Nothing changes in Graylog.

dialog.description: Search your Graylog logs from PatchMan. PatchMan only reads: it never changes anything in Graylog.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.urlHelp: The address you open Graylog at, e.g. https://graylog.example.com (the API is found under /api).
dialog.kindTokenDesc: Recommended. Create one in Graylog: your profile → Edit tokens.
dialog.kindBasicDesc: A Graylog user's login (not for single sign-on accounts).
dialog.tokenHelp: PatchMan sees the same streams this token's user can see in Graylog. The token is stored encrypted and never shown to people you share with.
dialog.basicHelp: PatchMan sees the same streams this user can see in Graylog. The password is stored encrypted and never shown to people you share with.
dialog.backendLocalDesc: The desktop app connects to Graylog from your machine.
dialog.backendRemoteDesc: The shared PatchMan server connects; works in the web app too.
dialog.backendNote: The connection is saved to both; this picks which one runs the searches.
dialog.testOk: Connected to Graylog {{version}} as {{user}} — {{count}} streams readable.

share.description: Let people or teams search logs through this Graylog connection.
share.identityWarning: People you share with search as this connection's Graylog user and see the same streams — the token or password itself is never shown to them.
